It may also symbolize the concept of "fortifying ourselves" through acts of worship, such as prayer and remembrance of Allah, and seeking knowledge and understanding of His teachings. Ultimately, the name Sabbaq encourages us to recognize the power and protection that comes from our connection to Allah, and to strive towards spiritual growth and inner strength.
